items.title: UnitedHealth (UNH) Q3 Earnings Lift Confidence In Margin Recovery
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group just released its Q3 2026 results, and the initial reaction from traders was calm confidence. The stock rose about 1.2% in regular trading to around $409, a measured move rather than a frenzy. The headline figure that set the tone was adjusted earnings per share of roughly $4.69 on revenue a little above $113b. items.title: UnitedHealth Stock And Medicare Advantage Insurers In Focus After Midterm Gridlock
items.summary: Democrats’ midterm gains have cooled talk of sweeping policy change and pushed investors toward areas where government programs quietly control the revenue tap. Medicaid and ACA-focused insurers suddenly look far more interesting as gridlock expectations firm up and healthcare reform risk feels less urgent. items.summary: UnitedHealth Group (NYSE:UNH) is facing renewed breakup calls from Senator Elizabeth Warren after its Amedisys acquisition settlement.
